The level of desperation and defeat is as clear as the “seven circles of hell” around Heydarian’s eyes, knowing they failed to extinguish the Duterte fire that continues to burn across the nation.

And the fear-mongering, a tool once used to subjugate Filipinos and something used by adults to scare children, does not only make Heydarian a horrible condescending baklang malaway at nangangamoy baklang malaway but also exposes his ignorance and the need for him to touch the grass around the slums of Manila or feed on balanghoy in the Visayas. 

Meanwhile, for the Sub-Saharan Africa Mindanao, Heydarian will always be a cross between the entrails of an elephant and the esophagus of a hyena. 

He needs a quarantine to enter.
